visuals.request:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: isolated found-object gift, transparent PNG.
Edit the supplied EMPTY amber cicada shed casing and its short twig. Preserve the hollow empty shell, visibly open dorsal split, amber thin translucent shell edges, intact head casing and segmented abdomen, same general coloring and charming pixel-illustration treatment, and genuine transparent background. Change ONLY the pose and view of the object to make ALL SIX LEGS individually identifiable.
Repose the shell to an elevated nearly top-down symmetrical view with the head toward the top of the square and abdomen toward the bottom. The same one complete short rough twig runs vertically under its center, projecting beyond head and tail. Show exactly THREE distinctly separated legs on the left and exactly THREE distinctly separated legs on the right: a front pair, middle pair, and hind pair. Each leg begins at the thorax side, arcs visibly outward around an open transparent gap, then curls back inward to hook the same twig bark. Separate adjacent legs vertically and by silhouette gaps so a viewer can count 1, 2, 3 on each side, even at 192 pixel display. No leg may disappear behind shell or twig, overlap another leg or blend into body plates. Six legs total, no extras. All six grips belong to the one twig.
Keep the empty opening on the upper back clearly visible between shell edges, not filled by a living insect. No active eyes or living body inside, no wings. Full twig stays intact and visible. Center only these two objects with transparent margins, no scenery, pet, hands, furniture, labels, paper border, text or watermark. Retain transparency.
